review_queue.summary: PhD Opportunities Within Our Lab The Auditory Cognitive Neuroscience Lab is seeking candidates for a PhD program who are interested in auditory processing, specifically related to hearing impairment, aging, tinnitus, hyperacusis and misophonia. The PhD may be obtained in the Department of Speech and Hearing Science or from the Graduate Program in Neuroscience, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign. Dr. Husain can mentor PhD students in either program. Our lab has been continuously funded to conduct brain imaging and behavioral research on hearing loss, tinnitus, and misophonia for the past 10 years.
